Initial release of dom-to-image.

- Convert HTML DOM nodes to PNG, JPEG, SVG, or Blob images.
- Supports customizable rendering options: filter, background color, quality, pixel ratio, and more.

- Supports usage with React components.
- Notes on compatibility and rendering limitations provided.
